message:

hold_reason: Refunds mismatch: Alpha reported batch refunds include order_id 211 (12701) plus 213 (15133) and 214 (6668), but current refunds table only shows 213 and 214. Cannot proceed with payouts.

reply.thought: I will verify the refunds table matches Alpha's reported batch refunds before paying customers, then fetch net balances and record one payout per customer.
The refunds table returned does not match the batch signed by Alpha (batch includes order_id 211 and expects three refunds). I must place the payout batch on hold for human review.
